profile_md: Dundee shows several distributed, programme-level client-project routes rather than an institution-wide scheme. In computing, CS32002 Industrial Team Project has student teams build software proposed by an industry client (module page: 'for an industrial client'; group portfolio, presentation, peer review). In mechanical engineering, ME32003 Engineering Design II includes a 10-week group task working directly with a local industry partner. DJCAD's Going Live (DJ52027) has students collaborate on a live brief from an industry partner, and Research Through Design (DJ53010) has a team address a brief set by an external problem holder (partner type unclear). In Dundee Business School, Marketing Research Project (BU40025) uses group consulting teams but clients may be University departments, so employer connection is unclear; other consultancy modules are individual reports. The Careers Employer Team offers MSc live projects for up to five students reporting individually. The Venture competition is enterprise-based and excluded. All module pages are undated and none was corroborated for 2025/26, so current delivery is unconfirmed (a Nov 2025 news feature does confirm business-school employer problems generally). Compulsory status and partner names remain unverified. No science, law or health route verified.
gaps: Module pages undated; no 2025/26 corroboration for any scheme. Compulsory status per programme not checked. Not tested: BE32001 biomedical engineering, Graphic Design/Illustration live briefs, DJ31015 collaborative briefs, Architecture studios, further departmental instances likely.
